correctness.rationale: For each current blue vertex, the number of white neighbours is the count of whites in its clique plus a single matching-partner indicator. This proves exactly which white-index profiles allow a first force and ensures full closure or immediate stall; disjoint profile counting gives every polynomial coefficient including n=2. A fort obeys the same neighbourhood-count condition, and all minimal fort cases a=1, b=1, a,b>=2, and exceptional n=2,3 are resolved by proper subset containment. The proof of the independent-color limit is an explicit two-binomial Poisson limit. A standalone program constructs edges and simulates actual forcing for every graph subset at n=2..8, and enumerates all proper subsets of candidate forts for n=2..7, agreeing exactly (VERIFY_OK 87376 direct subsets). Computations are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The complete prism K_n square K_2 is a canonical Cartesian graph product whose ordinary forcing number n and extremal failed size were known, whereas the exact coefficients and minimal fort hypergraph quantify nonminimal and minimal obstructions over all sizes. The two minimal-fort size strata, exceptional small orders, exact multiplicity of all optimal forcing sets and sharp independent-deletion scaling window are structural, infinite-family, naturally motivated information not recoverable from the scalar predecessors. The labelled enumeration is a substantive distributional result, not an arbitrary small numerical slice.
